summary.name: Hex Fiend
summary.one_liner: Hex Fiend is a fast, open source hex editor for macOS that can insert, delete and rearrange bytes and handles very large files.
use_cases: editing binary files on a Mac
opening and scrolling very large files
comparing two binary files with insertions or deletions
inspecting data as integers or floats
embedding a hex view in another macOS app
summary.what_it_does: Hex Fiend lets you insert, delete and rearrange data, not just overwrite bytes in place. It can open files of very large size and launches quickly without keeping the whole file in memory. It offers fast search, copy and paste, and a binary diff that accounts for insertions and deletions. Its data inspector interprets bytes as signed or unsigned integers or floating point, in big or little endian. Its hex and data views can also be embedded in other apps under a BSD-style license.
notable: Binary diff that handles insertions and deletions
Does not load whole file into memory; handles huge files
Smart saving only writes changed parts of files
Embeddable hex/data views under permissive BSD-style license
